'''''Claf 2''''' was a [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttle]] that was part of [[Claf group]] which served the [[Mugaari pirates]]. It fought at the [[Recapture of Outpost D-34|Second Battle of Javin]] where they carried equipment that may have been looted from [[Outpost D-34]], and then proceeded to attack the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Fogger]]''. However, all the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] were destroyed.
